data.one_liner: A PageView that snaps to the nearest page or scrolls multiple pages based on scroll velocity.
data.what_it_does: It provides a PageView-like widget that disables snapping when the user scrolls faster than a threshold, allowing multi-page scrolls, and re-enables snapping when the velocity slows. The widget can be controlled via a PageController.
use_when: You need a carousel that behaves differently based on swipe speed
You want to avoid page snapping during fast swipes
You prefer a declarative widget over custom scroll logic
avoid_when: You need fine-grained control over scroll physics beyond velocity thresholds
You are building a non-page-based scrollable list
strengths: Simple API, single widget, no extra dependencies
weaknesses: No support for custom scroll physics beyond velocity threshold
No built-in page indicators or animations
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml and import package
